CHOOSE  SCENARIO
TRAINING...



COASTAL...



FIRE & ICE...



GAME TOTAL...

MISSION 001  Helipads & Bell Buoys

Use the CURSOR KEYS to fly your helicopter around  the  islands. Press P to pause.

Gently land on each of the Helipads. 

Hover above each Bell Buoy to ring the bell.

Don't land too heavily or you will damage your helicopter. Complete the level at speed to earn a massive Time Bonus!

TOP TIP: Dab the keys to achieve smooth throttle and pitch control, and avoid  altitude oscillation.

MISSION 002 Introducing Cable Guy
Use spacebar to toggle the winch up / down.

Fly around  the  islands and hover above each pickup,  tap the spacebar to lower your cable guy down to grab the item. Tap the Spacebar again to haul up the goodies.


FUEL BARREL:				Raises fuel level

TOOL BOX :				Reduces damage level

TREASURE :				Huge points bonus

SEAGULL :				AVOID BIRD STRIKES!

MISSION 004 Oil Rig Rescue
You have passed your flight training!

Now use your skills in a real emergency.

An off shore oil rig has suffered structural collapse. Pickup the survivors from each life raft.

Drop the survivors off at Rescue HQ.

WARNING : Other rescue helicopters are operating in your flight space. AVOID them at all costs.

MISSION 005 Storm Force
A cargo ship has run aground on hazardous rocks near  the coastline.

Many lives hang in the balance! Can you save them all without running out of fuel?

Good Luck pilot!

WARNING: Take care when approaching the ship, as the huge waves may knock you sideways.

Simplified controls with fly-by-wire auto-hover.
Use this mode at first.
NOVICE

PRO
Subtle throttle and  pitch physics combine to provide the ultimate challenge !

MISSION 003 Flaming Palm Trees

Now it's time  for your final training session.

Master the water nozzle HOLDING DOWN the SPACEBAR to spray the water jet. The helicopter will not move left or right when spraying. Instead use the cursor keys to aim the water jet left and right.

Douse all the palm trees to complete the level!

WARNING: DON'T FAN THE FLAMES! Avoid hovering directly over the flames, spray at a distance. 
TIP: To douse the flames much faster, slowly sway the spray back and forth across the base of the fire.

MISSION 006 Nuclear Combustion
The local nuclear test facility is in serious trouble!
Can you avoid total meltdown?

Douse all the flames, and rescue the workers and scientists.

Lock down the burst steam vents with your water jet to get past them safely. Don't take too long!

Use the cableGuy to pull every reactor fuel rod up into the raised position, then douse the rod to cool it down.

Caution: Do not fly too close to the large power transformers!

MISSION 007 Ice Station
You have been sent on assignment to gain experience in the harsh extremes of Iceland. An SOS has been received from the local weather research station.

Your hose will not work in the sub zero temperatures. Find a novel way to extinguish the fires!

Use your down thrust to blow away snow drifts that have burried researchers. Then pull them to safety.

Use cableGuy to pull the comm towers back up into position whilst avoiding the escaped weather balloons!

WARNING: You must work at speed as there is ONLY ONE FUEL BARREL on this level!

MISSION 008 Sub Zero Sub
A foreign nuclear submarine has surfaced through the ice after experiencing electrical systems failure!

Rescue the sailors from the submarine. Unscrew each warhead then deliver it to the nuclear incident decontamination ship. Lower each warhead carefully into the ship's hold!

WARNING: Terrorists are trying to steal the nuclear warheads. Avoid their menacing black helicopters and dodge the ground to air missiles!

FIGHT BACK: Can you find a way to tilt the terrorists from their icebergs?

MISSION 009 Manic Volcanic
Oh-oh, you have angered some dangerous people protecting those warheads! In a despicable act of revenge they have KIDNAPPED CABLEGUY!!!!

Chase the black helicopter, dodging until it has used up its TEN missile payload. Then skilfully manouvre above them and use your down draught to force them to land. Use the high ground to force them down quicker! 

TIP: Chase the black helicopter full speed and JINK up and down to avoid the homing missiles.

QUICK GET GOING! CableGuy can't hold on much longer!
